{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}You think they were talkin' about the previous transmission then?{PART_001}Maybe that explains those suspiciously easy ones...

{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Abstract,{PART_001}relating not to the tangible,{PART_002}but to the conceptual.{PART_003}I will be very very happy if this term fits "abstract."{PART_004}A world of language will open up before us.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}The name's Bond,{PART_001}Chemical Bond.{PART_002}...{PART_003}Akers would have gotten a kick out of that.{PART_004}It's a movie reference.
{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}Yes,{PART_001}it is my favorite film series.{PART_002}Agent 007 is the best.

{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}I knew it as soon as I said it.{PART_001}Sorry.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}I see you appreciated the vocabulary I shared!{PART_001}I'm pleased to see a linguist's word in the dictionary :)
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}"Nice", huh?{PART_001}I suppose that's the closest we will get to hearing one of Bautista's 'clean's.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}I remain doubtful.{PART_001}We're moving away from math and towards language.{PART_002}I fear single character terms are behind us.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}The aliens have deemed it of particular importance it seems.{PART_001}Intriguing.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}The first signal was 0, so it's a fair guess.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Hey! That could be what the meteor wants!
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Just seems like a lazy guess, that's all.
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Zero??? If this is answer, I'm gonna be mad.
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Ah, the ultimate question of life, the universe, and everything.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Yeah, but something about it rubs me the wrong way. It doesn't feel like it fits with the rest of our language."

{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}No.{PART_001}Bad idea.{PART_002}We are designing radio transmissions.{PART_003}Use numbers.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Though,{PART_001}it would be nice if we could input words and somehow turn those into radio frequencies.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Even if it did,{PART_001}I'm stuck wondering what good that would do...

{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Ya know,{PART_001}we've spent a while with this signal.{PART_002}$animA4I'm startin' to think once we get -9,{PART_003}we'll be all done.{PART_004}-9 is probably our last signal$animA3.{PART_005}Once we get that,{PART_006}we'll have a full set of 10.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}$animC2I hope not!{PART_001}If all this meteor contained was a set of math problems,{PART_002}$animC5I'd be less than thrilled.

{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}Collins.{PART_001}$animB3Never stop a fool from parting ways with his money.

{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}$animC3And we can input those smaller,{PART_001}adjusted numbers then, $animC0too?

{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}$animA4So that means no more memorizin' a bunch of digits,{PART_001}before flipping between screens due to,{PART_002}$animA2well,{PART_003}$animA5your poor programming skills.
{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}Hm.{PART_001}$animB5I update the computer and am thanked with an insult.{PART_002}$animB0Maybe you will see less improvements in your workstation.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}$animC3Hey!{PART_001}Don't catch me in the crossfire here!
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Octagon {SIG_N022} and {SIG_N021},{PART_001}that was...{PART_002}$animC5surprisingly esoteric to say the least.
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}If esoteric means hard,{PART_001}$animA4then yeah I agree!

{SPEAKER_DOPPLER}{PART_000}Yeah…{PART_001}It is…{PART_002}But,{PART_003}is that not amazing?{PART_004}It's the same system,{PART_005}just microscopically tiny.
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}I get it!{PART_001}Halfway across the universe,{PART_002}and they're using the same tech as us.
{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}Hmm.{PART_001}If we are assuming this is not human-made.
{SPEAKER_DOPPLER}{PART_000}Huh?{PART_001}Not sure I follow.{PART_002}Anyway,{PART_003}I'm sure now you all understand why I had to share it!

{SPEAKER_DOPPLER}{PART_000}Of course.{PART_001}Anytime!{PART_002}Anytime we have something to share, that is.{PART_003}And that goes for you four,{PART_004}as well.{PART_005}Keep me posted.{PART_006}We learn why they are sent this meteor,{PART_007}if they are asking for anything,{PART_008}offering anything,{PART_009}sharing how to find them—{PART_010}any of the above,{PART_011}come find me!{PART_012}I'll be around the facility.

{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}$animA1What are we even looking at here?
{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}$animB23 radio frequencies,{PART_001}values offset by 1.4 billion,{PART_002}with subzero values encoded by a 2-way hashtable.
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}$animB0Oh great,{PART_001}Bautista.{PART_002}$animA3What would we do without you,{PART_003}and your sass?
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Working in base 8 is horribly confusing.{PART_001}I want to get used to it,{PART_002}but whew,{PART_003}$animA3why couldn't the aliens just use base 10 for us??
{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}Get used to it.{PART_001}It is the same as base 10,{PART_002}but 8.
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}That's a big difference!{PART_001}$animA5A difference I kinda understand but it kinda breaks my brain.
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}$animA4Not everyone is a computer whiz like you!{PART_001}$animA2I love computers!{PART_002}I think in binary!{PART_003}Beep boop! Beep boop!

{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}$animB0Poor impression,{PART_001}but I have to admit,{PART_002}$animC5I'm with Akers.{PART_003}Working in base 8 is frustrating to say the least.{PART_004}$animC3I have mostly relied on {PLAYER_NAME} through this stretch.
{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}If you insist,{PART_001}Dr. Collins.{PART_002}$animB5I will work on something to convert to base 10 numbers.

{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}$animC5About the alien's base-8 number system--{PART_001}A few years back,{PART_002}psychologist George Miller,{PART_003}$animC3researched what humans can cognitively handle—{PART_004}asking how many objects can we mentally juggle simultaneously.{PART_005}He found a magic number.
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}$animA1You're thinking that rule applies to these aliens,{PART_001}but for the number 8!

{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Exactly!!{PART_001}$animC3Perhaps they can conceptualize 8 concepts at once,{PART_002}$animA0so they made the assumption that whoever or whatever would receive this message,{PART_003}would process information similarly.
{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}Dr. Collins,{PART_001}I have doubts about your "magic number" theory for 8 digits.
{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}$animB4Convenience.{PART_001}Computers and communication protocols love powers of 2.{PART_002}8 is 2 cubed.{PART_003}$animB5It is merely convenient.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}I have another theory on the 8 digits.
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Is this theory interesting?{PART_001}$animA5Bautista's last theory,{PART_002}though sound,{PART_003}was less than exciting...
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}What if the number 8 is culturally,{PART_001}$animC3or biologically significant?
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Why do we use 10 digits—{PART_001}0 through 9?{PART_002}$animC2Why is it us humans primarily use base 10 numbers?
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Hey,{PART_001}how come the previous transmissions haven't been updated for base 10.
{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}I left them the same,{PART_001}so we can always go back to see their number formatting.
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Makes sense.{PART_001}It's funny how simple some of these look once the hydrogen line is subtracted,{PART_002}and now they're in base 10.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Dr. Bautista,{PART_001}any update on that base 10 converter?
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}So Bautista,{PART_001}how'd you make the info tab?{PART_002}Did you just know all that stuff?
{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}No.{PART_001}Doppler gave me money to buy encyclopedias.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Yeah!{PART_001}Dr. Doppler will pretty much give you money to do anything if you just ask.
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Oh good!{PART_001}I think the noble Dr. Akers is due for a pay raise!
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Bautista,{PART_001}must we play this game every time?{PART_002}Spill it.{PART_003}What's the update?
{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}Calculator.{PART_001}It is quite rudimentary.{PART_002}If you use another calculator,{PART_003}I do not blame you.
{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}There are settings in the dictionary to choose the formatting for each word.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}So we can customize how the compiler organizes our words?
{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}Mmhm.{PART_001}{SIG_N001} should be set to "append no space."{PART_002}Try it.

{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Dr. Bautista,{PART_001}please don't tell me that this was the update you were busy coding.{PART_002}I imagine making a base-8 to base-10 number compiler is of higher priority.
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Hey!{PART_001}Dr. Robot actually made something fun!{PART_002}Look how cool this is!{PART_003}We have confetti now!
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}I can't wait to solve the next one!{PART_001}I want more confetti!!
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Ahh,{PART_001}and our newest signal is next in line!{PART_002}No gaps in our dictionary!
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}I still don't get what that means.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}I heard you guys the first time.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}I'm picking up a pattern in these transmissions.

{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}A new signal appears.{PART_001}We see it used in a few examples.{PART_002}Then the meteor waits for a response,{PART_003}a response that proves some understanding of the concept.

{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}They're teaching us and testing us,{PART_001}as we progress.{PART_002}If we go astray on our translation,{PART_003}we won't get too far.{PART_004}We would be forced to reconcile any of our misunderstood definitions.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}We define words,{PART_001}test if the definitions hold,{PART_002}and press on.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Come to think of it,{PART_001}the happy dictionary ideal–{PART_002}It's telling of something:{PART_003}Why aren't the signals all just in numerical order?
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Why isn't -3 the third subzero signal we encounter,{PART_001}and -4 the 4th?
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Why do they do addition backwards?{PART_001}They put addend,{PART_002}addend,{PART_003}operation,{PART_004}then result.{PART_005}It's backwards.

{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}But math is universal.{PART_001}It's the same everywhere.
{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}The math is the same,{PART_001}not the syntax.
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}I guess.{PART_001}But it's still gonna need some getting used to.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}That last transmission was tough to piece together.{PART_001}Nice solve, {PLAYER_NAME}.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Dr. Bautista!{PART_001}I told you to sleep last night!{PART_002}That was a direct order from Doppler!
{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}Seems indirect if I heard it from you.
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Ya know,{PART_001}Bautista,{PART_002}there's no overtime pay.{PART_003}Trust me, I asked Doppler.
{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}I was not aware.{PART_001}But,{PART_002}I do not care.

{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Well,{PART_001}I can't say I'm left unimpressed by your dedication to this mission,{PART_002}working without pay and all,{PART_003}but sleep is a priority.{PART_004}Do you know what happens when your brain is low on sleep?{PART_005}When we sleep,{PART_006}our brain processes waste—
{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}One moment.{PART_001}I am working on an update.
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Is it just me or did that transmission absolutely stink?
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}I suspect that the meteor is testing our problem solving abilities.

{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Approximately 2.71 is Euler's Number,{PART_001}commonly referred to as 'e'.{PART_002}It's a mathematical constant that describes continuous growth.{PART_003}It's a big deal to nerds like Bautista.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Another universal constant!{PART_001}They're throwing us a bone,{PART_002}something familiar to us.
{SPEAKER_BAUTISTA}{PART_000}Like pi.{PART_001}Hmm.{PART_002}Maybe we will see pi later.
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Oh, nice!{PART_001}That transmission was a bit tough.
{SPEAKER_COLLINS}{PART_000}Indeed.{PART_001}Perhaps they were assessing our problem-solving abilities.
{SPEAKER_AKERS}{PART_000}Well,{PART_001}their alien riddles are no match for me,{PART_002}Dr. Alan Akers the Astronomer Extraordinaire!
